resources.string: Supports: VLESS (Reality/TLS/WS/gRPC/xHTTP + PQC encryption) • VMess • Trojan • Shadowsocks • Hysteria2 (native client + Salamander/Gecko) • SSR • TUIC • ShadowTLS • AnyTLS • SNIc (parsed; some may not be in the Xray core)

v1.0.14
• App identity changed: all channel traces were removed from the package name and the signing certificate — for THIS version uninstall the old app first; future updates install over it
• Fixed: changing the language keeps you on the Settings tab (it no longer jumps back to the test page)
• Fixed: Appearance rows no longer stick together in Persian; long button labels shortened so the option boxes stay uniform
• In-app app update hardened: crashes are now written to the app log (Log button) and the installer has a fallback through the public Downloads folder
• Removed dead code

v1.0.13
• Core update: the downloaded package is now kept — after a failed install it continues from the cache (no re-download); it is deleted only after a successful install
• Core update: a live progress bar with percentage right under the core version, and the same for the app update
• Core update: never downgrades — if the current core is newer, it says so instead of replacing it
• Core update: extra install routes tried before giving up; if the device still blocks it, a clear dialog offers the app update (new app versions ship the new core built in)
• New: the app now ships Xray 26.7.28 (previously 26.3.27)
• Appearance: Language and Theme are now two tap-to-expand rows with their options inside
• New: a small box under the results with just the exit flags (tap it to copy)

v1.0.12
• Fixed: the core update bug — the downloaded package was never unzipped (that is why the update always failed)
• Core update now shows live progress (percent + size) and retries once on network hiccups
• Less Play Protect nagging: the app no longer declares the install permission; it asks for it only when you actually use the in-app update
• Much glassier theme: panels are more transparent over a deeper gradient, cleaner color palette in light & dark mode
• New app icon: a scanner radar — what the app actually does

v1.0.11
• Settings: Xray core update moved to Settings — one Update button + beta tick (on = newest release incl. pre-release, off = newest stable)
• New: in-app app update (checks GitHub, downloads the new APK, installs it)
• The water circle now appears only while a run is active (clean start screen)
• New: SSR, TUIC, ShadowTLS, AnyTLS and SNIc links are now parsed (note: the official Xray core no longer ships these protocols)
• New: Android 12+ Material You wallpaper color palette support

v1.0.10
• New: XHTTP transport support (type=xhttp links now work)
• New: VLESS post-quantum encryption (mlkem768x25519plus / 0-RTT links now work)
• New: xhttp xPaddingBytes option

v1.0.9
• Security: the signing key password is no longer in the source (now read from an environment variable)
• Fixed: in-app Xray core update — it now installs into the app storage; if the device blocks it, the app opens the releases page so you can install a newer APK
• Fixed: Shadowsocks legacy links whose password contains ":"
• Fixed: a rare progress counter race, stronger free-port search, and disabled app-data backup

v1.0.8
• Log can now be saved as a .txt file (Log button → Save as .txt)
• New iOS lock-screen glass look: frosted panels over a soft gradient background
• Much bigger water circle, now always visible at the top of the screen
• New modern app icon
• Clearer explanations in Settings



v1.0.7
• Dark & Light mode: theme switch (System / Dark / Light) in Settings
• New Settings tab: channel, parallelism, timeout, language and theme moved to their own tab
• New animated water-circle progress: the circle fills with water as the test advances
• Geo check is now parallel over 6 services (was 3 in series) — slow/filtered exits are detected much more often
• Fixed: no more scroll jumps/jitter while a run is in progress



v1.0.6
• Hysteria2: the Hysteria native client is now built in — Salamander and Gecko obfs links now work (the Xray core obfs implementation was broken upstream)
• Hysteria2: fixed parsing of the obfs-password parameter (salamander links now actually get tested)
• Hysteria2: insecure=1 links are tested directly
• Xray logging fixed: Xray 26.x renamed the log file field, so errors are now actually written to the log

v1.0.5
• Bilingual: English / Persian, with a language switch
• Hysteria2: forced classic key exchange (x25519) — the new post-quantum exchange broke the connection
• Hysteria2: SNI is now set automatically
• insecure=1 links: the server certificate is fetched and pinned automatically
• Better Xray logging: exact errors are now written to the log
• Fixed: after a run finishes the app returns to the start state
• Stable signing: future updates install over the previous version (no uninstall needed)

v1.0.3
• allowInsecure fix (removed in new Xray)
• Xray error tail in app log on failure

v1.0.2
• Core moved to jniLibs (exec error=13 fixed)

v1.0.1
• Log button for debugging

v1.0.0
• Initial release
